text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English.
zh: 你好，欢迎收听《真正简易英语》。
zh_hant: 你好，歡迎收聽《真正簡易英語》。

text: We're back with another conversation in Easy English to help you learn.
zh: 我们带着另一段简易英语对话回来了，帮你学习。
zh_hant: 我們帶著另一段簡易英語對話回來了，幫你學習。

text: I'm Georgie.
And I'm Phil.
And you can find a video version of this podcast with subtitles to help you
zh: 你可以在我们的网站上找到这个播客的视频版本，带字幕
zh_hant: 你可以在我們的網站上找到這個播客的影片版本，帶字幕

text: on our website, and that's at bbclearningenglish.com.
Hello Phil, how are you?
I'm good, but I'm also a little bit tired
because I've been doing DIY all weekend.
zh: 因为整个周末我都在做DIY。
zh_hant: 因為整個週末我都在做DIY。

text: Well, that's lucky, because today we're talking about DIY.
zh: 那真巧，因为今天我们就聊DIY。
zh_hant: 那真巧，因為今天我們就聊DIY。

text: stands for do it yourself,
and it means doing things to your home,
zh: 意思是对你的家做一些事情，
zh_hant: 意思是對你的家做一些事情，

text: such as fixing and painting.
So what kind of DIY have you been doing this weekend?
zh: 那么这周末你做了什么DIY？
zh_hant: 那麼這週末你做了什麼DIY？

text: Yes, I've been trying to fix my water tank.
zh: 对，我一直试着修我的水箱。
zh_hant: 對，我一直試著修我的水箱。

text: Okay.
And do you do a lot of DIY?
More than I want to.
I'm not very good at DIY.
If it's something I can do, I will try and do it.
zh: 如果是我能做的事，我会试着去做。
zh_hant: 如果是我能做的事，我會試著去做。

text: Some things I would never touch, like electrics,
zh: 有些东西我绝不碰，比如电路
zh_hant: 有些東西我絕不碰，比如電路

text: I wouldn't go anywhere near that, or gas, because it's not safe.
zh: 我不会靠近那些，或者燃气，因为不安全。
zh_hant: 我不會靠近那些，或者燃氣，因為不安全。

text: But if it's something that looks safe and I think I can do it,
zh: 但如果某件事看起来安全且我觉得我能做到，
zh_hant: 但如果某件事看起來安全且我覺得我能做到，

text: I will try it.
Okay, so what kinds of things do you do around the house?
zh: 好，那你通常在家里做什么？
zh_hant: 好，那你通常在家裡做什麼？

text: It could be things like painting and decorating a house, making it look nice.
zh: 可能是像粉刷和装修房子，让它看起来好看。
zh_hant: 可能是像粉刷和裝修房子，讓它看起來好看。

text: That I quite like.
can do that sometimes fixing things
with bits of wood that need to go somewhere,
I can do that, putting up fences,
I could do that, but that's probably it.
zh: 我也能行，但可能就这些了。
zh_hant: 我也能行，但可能就這些了。

text: What about you Georgie?
Do you do much DIY?
No, I don't.
I actually rent my flat,
so that means I can't really do much to the place because it's not mine,
zh: 所以我对住处不能大改，因为不是我的，
zh_hant: 所以我對住處不能大改，因為不是我的，

text: but recently I have put up some
lights in my room because I changed rooms,
zh: 房间里的灯，因为我换了房间，
zh_hant: 房間裡的燈，因為我換了房間，

text: so I've put up some nice fairy lights on the Wall,
zh: 所以我在墙上挂了漂亮的彩灯，
zh_hant: 所以我在牆上掛了漂亮的彩燈，

text: and I've put up some frames with art and photos.
zh: 还挂了一些带艺术画和照片的相框。
zh_hant: 還掛了一些帶藝術畫和照片的相框。

text: So that's probably my limit.
I wouldn't do anything else.
Do you enjoy DIY?
No, I don't, because I'm quite a lazy person.
So if I see that something is broken or needs fixing,
zh: 所以如果我看到某样东西坏了或需要修理，
zh_hant: 所以如果我看到某樣東西壞了或需要修理，

text: I will just ignore it, procrastinate,
which means to delay something, postpone it,
zh: 意思就是延迟事情，推迟它，
zh_hant: 意思就是延遲事情，推遲它，

text: and wait for someone else to do it.
I kind of get used to things being broken and forget that it's like that.
zh: 我有点习惯了东西坏掉，都忘了它是那样的了。
zh_hant: 我有點習慣了東西壞掉，都忘了它是那樣的了。

text: So yeah, I'm just a bit lazy.
Phil, have you ever put together furniture,
zh: 菲尔，你有没有组装过家具，
zh_hant: 菲爾，你有沒有組裝過傢俱，

text: like flat pack furniture?
Yes, yes, I've done that.
Yeah, quite a lot because, yeah,
a lot of furniture you buy that's fairly cheap, you have to do that.
zh: 很多便宜点的家具都要自己组装。
zh_hant: 很多便宜點的傢俱都要自己組裝。

text: I don't actually mind that.
I quite like that.
It's quite good to do it with someone and you work as a team.
zh: 和别人一起做挺好的，团队合作。
zh_hant: 和別人一起做挺好的，團隊合作。

text: Like an activity.
Yes, yes, it can.
Well, sometimes it's fun, sometimes it's stressful.
Yeah, if it goes well, that can be a nice thing to do with someone.
zh: 对，如果顺利，和别人一起做是件好事。
zh_hant: 對，如果順利，和別人一起做是件好事。

text: But if it goes badly, it could lead to an argument.
zh: 但如果搞砸了，可能会吵架。
zh_hant: 但如果搞砸了，可能會吵架。

text: Do you have any big plans for your house?
zh: 你对房子有什么大计划吗？
zh_hant: 你對房子有什麼大計劃嗎？

text: I would really like to get a very nice bit of wood
and make a nice bar for my kitchen.
zh: 给厨房做个好看的吧台。
zh_hant: 給廚房做個好看的吧檯。

text: I'd love to do that, but it's expensive and I haven't done it yet.
zh: 我很想做，但太贵了，而且我还没做。
zh_hant: 我很想做，但太貴了，而且我還沒做。

text: I keep procrastinating and not doing it.
what about you?
I rent my flat, so I can't do anything big.
zh: 我租房子，所以不能做大事。
zh_hant: 我租房子，所以不能做大事。

text: I don't have big plans, but we do have an outdoor terrace,
zh: 我没有大计划，但我们有个户外露台，
zh_hant: 我沒有大計劃，但我們有個戶外露臺，

text: which at the moment it's not in a very good state.
So I would like to clean it,
maybe get some plants for it.
I'd like to put some lights out there, actually,
zh: 我其实想在外面装些灯，
zh_hant: 我其實想在外面裝些燈，

text: so that when people come round,
it will be really nice in the evenings.
So, yeah, that's my plan, ready for the summer.
zh: 所以，这就是我的计划，为夏天准备。
zh_hant: 所以，這就是我的計劃，為夏天準備。

text: That sounds lovely.
OK, let's recap the language we heard during the conversation,
zh: 好，我们回顾一下对话里听到的语言，
zh_hant: 好，我們回顧一下對話裡聽到的語言，

text: starting with DIY, which stands for do-it-yourself.
zh: 先从DIY开始，它代表自己动手。
zh_hant: 先從DIY開始，它代表自己動手。

text: These are jobs you do around the house, like fixing or painting.
zh: 这些是你家里做的活儿，比如修理或粉刷。
zh_hant: 這些是你家裡做的活兒，比如修理或粉刷。

text: For example, I don't like DIY.
I'm too lazy.
We also heard decorate,
which means paint a room or change how We heard flat pack furniture,
zh: 也就是说，粉刷房间或改变我们听到的平板包装家具的方式，
zh_hant: 也就是說，粉刷房間或改變我們聽到的平板包裝傢俱的方式，

text: which is furniture which comes with instructions so that you can build it yourself.
zh: 这种家具带说明书，让你自己组装。
zh_hant: 這種傢俱帶說明書，讓你自己組裝。

text: And we heard a couple of phrasal verbs.
zh: 我们还听到了几个动词短语。
zh_hant: 我們還聽到了幾個動詞短語。

text: If you put something up, you fix it to the wall.
zh: 如果你put something up，就是把它固定在墙上。
zh_hant: 如果你put something up，就是把它固定在牆上。

text: So, for example, Georgie put up some picture frames in her bedroom.
zh: 比如，乔治在卧室挂了几个相框。
zh_hant: 比如，喬治在臥室掛了幾個相框。

text: And if you put something together, you build it.
zh: 如果你put something together，就是组装。
zh_hant: 如果你put something together，就是組裝。

text: For example, Phil likes to put together flat pack furniture with someone else.
zh: 比如，菲尔喜欢和别人一起组装平板包装家具。
zh_hant: 比如，菲爾喜歡和別人一起組裝平板包裝傢俱。

text: And that's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 这就是本期《真正简易英语》的全部内容。
zh_hant: 這就是本期《真正簡易英語》的全部內容。

text: You can practice what you've learnt with a worksheet that's on our website bbclearningenglish.com.
zh: 你可以在我们的网站bbclearningenglish.com上找到练习表，来实践你学到的内容。
zh_hant: 你可以在我們的網站bbclearningenglish.com上找到練習表，來實踐你學到的內容。

text: And we'll be back next week with another conversation in Easy English.
zh: 下周我们会带着另一段简易英语对话回来。
zh_hant: 下週我們會帶著另一段簡易英語對話回來。

text: Goodbye for now.
Bye.
